+
+describe('Request ID Middleware with trustIncoming', () => {
+  describe('trustIncoming: true (default)', () => {
+    const app = new Hono()
+    app.use('/default', requestId())
+    app.use('/explicit', requestId({ trustIncoming: true }))
+    app.get('/default', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+    app.get('/explicit', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+
+    it('Should use the incoming request id by default', async () => {
+      const res = await app.request('http://localhost/default', {
+        headers: {
+          'X-Request-Id': 'hono-is-hot',
+        },
+      })
+      expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+      expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+      expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('hono-is-hot')
+      expect(await res.text()).toBe('hono-is-hot')
+    })
+
+    it('Should use the incoming request id when trustIncoming is explicitly true', async () => {
+      const res = await app.request('http://localhost/explicit', {
+        headers: {
+          'X-Request-Id': 'hono-is-hot',
+        },
+      })
+      expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+      expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+      expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('hono-is-hot')
+      expect(await res.text()).toBe('hono-is-hot')
+    })
+
+    it('Should generate a request id when no incoming header is present', async () => {
+      const res = await app.request('http://localhost/default')
+      expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+      expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+      expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toMatch(regexUUIDv4)
+      expect(await res.text()).toMatch(regexUUIDv4)
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('trustIncoming: false', () => {
+    function generateWord() {
+      return 'HonoIsWebFramework'
+    }
+
+    const app = new Hono()
+    app.use('/word', requestId({ trustIncoming: false, generator: generateWord }))
+    app.use('/uuid', requestId({ trustIncoming: false }))
+    app.get('/word', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+    app.get('/uuid', (c) => c.text(c.get('requestId') ?? 'No Request ID'))
+
+    it('Should ignore the incoming request id and always use the generator', async () => {
+      const res = await app.request('http://localhost/word', {
+        headers: {
+          'X-Request-Id': 'hono-is-hot',
+        },
+      })
+      expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+      expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+      expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('HonoIsWebFramework')
+      expect(await res.text()).toBe('HonoIsWebFramework')
+    })
+
+    it('Should ignore the incoming request id and generate a random one', async () => {
+      const res = await app.request('http://localhost/uuid', {
+        headers: {
+          'X-Request-Id': 'hono-is-hot',
+        },
+      })
+      expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+      expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+      expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toMatch(regexUUIDv4)
+      expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).not.toBe('hono-is-hot')
+      expect(await res.text()).toMatch(regexUUIDv4)
+      expect(await res.text()).not.toBe('hono-is-hot')
+    })
+
+    it('Should generate a request id when no incoming header is present', async () => {
+      const res = await app.request('http://localhost/word')
+      expect(res).not.toBeNull()
+      expect(res.status).toBe(200)
+      expect(res.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).toBe('HonoIsWebFramework')
+      expect(await res.text()).toBe('HonoIsWebFramework')
+    })
+  })
+})

Done. All changes are unstaged for your review.

## Changes

**`src/middleware/request-id/request-id.ts`**
- `RequestIdOptions` gains `trustIncoming?: boolean` (line 17) with JSDoc (line 27).
- Option destructured with `trustIncoming = true` (line 47), preserving existing behavior by default.
- Incoming header is only read when `headerName && trustIncoming` (lines 50-52). When `trustIncoming: false` the ID is always produced by `generator(c)`, and it is still written via `c.set('requestId', ...)` and the response header (lines 56-59), so `c.get('requestId')` and the header both reflect the generated value.

**`src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts`**
- New `describe('Request ID Middleware with trustIncoming')` block:
  - **Default/explicit true**: incoming `X-Request-Id` is honored for both `requestId()` and `requestId({ trustIncoming: true })`; generates a UUID when no header is sent.
  - **`trustIncoming: false`**: ignores an incoming ID and uses a custom generator (`HonoIsWebFramework`), ignores it and generates a UUID with the default generator, and works with no header present — asserting both the response header and the value read from `c.get('requestId')`.

## Verification
- `pnpm exec vp test --run src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts` → **Test Files 1 passed, Tests 17 passed** (10 new tests included).
- `pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json` → exit 0.
